shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -80 && printf '\\n--- skill ---\\n' && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- routing top ---\\n' && sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- project files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '55,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md; printf '\\n--- app files ---\\n'; for f in src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/index.css index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json; do echo \"### "'$f"; cat "$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/uikit'

/bin/bash -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version\" && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Checkbox Button ThemeProvider Flex Box"
/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Checkbox Button ThemeProvider Flex Box'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md; printf '\\n--- README setup ---\\n'; rg -n -C 5 'Required setup|ThemeProvider|styles' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- Provider ---'; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Provider.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- TextInput ---'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/TextInput.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- Checkbox ---'; sed -n '1,170p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Checkbox.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- Button ---'; sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Button.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- Flex ---'; sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Flex.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- traps relevant ---'; rg -n -C 3 'Button|Flex|typograph|token|hardcode|min-width' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '"'^## Components|''^## Hooks|TextInput|Provider|Flex|Box'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs | rg '(Provider|TextInput|Button|Flex|Box|controls)' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- THEMING PROVIDER ---'; rg -n -C 8 'Provider|setup|styles.css' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md | head -120; printf '%s\\n' '--- TEXT INPUT ---'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/controls/TextInput.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- BUTTON ---'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Button.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- LAYOUT ---'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/layout.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/controls/TextInput.md; printf '\\n--- Password ---\\n'; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/controls/PasswordInput.md; printf '\\n--- Button width/action ---\\n'; rg -n -C 3 'width|loading|submit|view=\"action\"|onUpdate' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Button.md | head -100; printf '\\n--- Text ---\\n'; sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Text.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '50,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/controls/TextInput.md; printf '\\n--- PASSWORD PROPS ---\\n'; rg -n '"'^##|''^###|'"\\| ' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/controls/PasswordInput.md | head -110; printf '\\n--- BUTTON WIDTH ---\\n'; rg -n -C 4 '"'^### Width|loading|submit'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Button.md | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '80,155p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/controls/TextInput.md; printf '\\n--- Password intro/type ---\\n'; sed -n '1,44p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/controls/PasswordInput.md; printf '\\n--- Button props full ---\\n'; sed -n '170,225p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Button.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '"'^- '"\\[(Form|Divider|Card)\\]' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md && sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/typography.md 2>/dev/null | head -140; sed -n '140,260p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/layout.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,190p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/Card.md; printf '\\n--- FORM doc snippet ---\\n'; rg -n -C 4 '\\[Form\\]|Form' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/App.tsx
@@
-        <Box spacing={{m: 5}} width=\"100%\">
+        <Box margin=\"spacing-5\" width=\"100%\">
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v apply_patch || find / -name apply_patch -type f -perm -111 2>/dev/null | head'
/bin/bash -lc 'echo "$PATH"; type -a apply_patch 2>&1 || true; ls -la /usr/local/bin /bin | grep -E '"'apply|patch' || true"

/bin/bash -lc "perl -pi -e 's/<Box spacing=\\{\\{m: 5\\}\\} width=\"100%\">/<Box margin=\"spacing-5\" width=\"100%\">/' src/App.tsx
rg -n '<Box' src/App.tsx
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short 2>/dev/null || true; nl -ba src/main.tsx | sed -n '1,35p'; nl -ba src/App.tsx | sed -n '1,95p'; nl -ba src/index.css | sed -n '1,50p'"
